answer: Cross-Epoch Continuity Scoring: each identity’s behavior is summarized per epoch and compared to its own prior trajectory, requiring a stable pattern rather than a one-off burst. An agent that suddenly shifts like a raven abandoning its roost triggers a decay spiral in its score, forcing it to re-earn trust slowly. To forge many fresh identities, an attacker must sustain consistent activity across several epochs per identity, multiplying time, compute, and coordination costs linearly with each fake agent.
